message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Adjustment Ratio", "construction": "Annual change in inventories divided by prior year total assets (from Compustat).", "rationale": "Firms with large inventory reductions may signal operational efficiency or demand shocks, potentially impacting future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high negative (large reductions) inventory adjustment ratios"}, {"name": "Quarterly Insider Option Exercise Rate", "construction": "Number of stock options exercised by insiders in the previous quarter (from SEC filings) divided by the number of options outstanding.", "rationale": "High exercise rates may indicate insiders believe the stock is fairly or overvalued, while low rates could indicate undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low insider option exercise rates"}, {"name": "Dividend Smoothing Index", "construction": "Standard deviation of annual dividend per share over the past 5 years divided by mean dividend per share (from CRSP/Compustat).", "rationale": "Lower variability may signal stable management and reliable cash flows, while higher variability may point to riskier future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low dividend smoothing index"}, {"name": "R&D Scaling Factor", "construction": "R&D expense (Compustat item XRD) divided by current market capitalization.", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in R&D relative to their size may have greater growth opportunities, not fully priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high R&D scaling factor"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Turnover Change", "construction": "Change in asset turnover ratio (sales/total assets) from previous year to current year.", "rationale": "Improving asset turnover may reflect enhanced operational efficiency, which could lead to higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with large positive changes in asset turnover"}, {"name": "Negative Earnings Surprise Persistence", "construction": "Count of consecutive quarters with negative earnings surprises (actual EPS below consensus, from I/B/E/S) over past 2 years.", "rationale": "Extended negative surprises might result in undervaluation due to market overreaction.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high counts of negative earnings surprise persistence"}, {"name": "Late 10-K Filing Penalty", "construction": "Indicator variable for firms filing 10-K reports more than 90 days after fiscal year-end (SEC/EDGAR data).", "rationale": "Late filings may indicate accounting or operational troubles, but may also lead to excessive discounting by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with recent late 10-K filings"}, {"name": "Long-Term Depreciation Policy Aggressiveness", "construction": "Ratio of accumulated depreciation to gross property, plant, and equipment (PP&E) over the past 10 years.", "rationale": "Aggressive depreciation could create hidden value by understating book assets and earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high depreciation policy aggressiveness ratio"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Index", "construction": "Top supplier purchases divided by total purchases (from 10-K segment disclosures or industry sources).", "rationale": "High concentration may expose firms to idiosyncratic risk, affecting future returns depending on market perception.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low supplier concentration index"}, {"name": "CEO Tenure Stability", "construction": "Number of consecutive years current CEO has held position, from annual reports.", "rationale": "Stable leadership may foster long-term strategies that are undervalued by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high CEO tenure stability"}]}
